## 4. Key factual corrections (DO NOT follow the old data)

Verified by the comprehensive audit of May 31. **Prevail** over any historical document.

**4.1 PID / PWM (#121 / B1) — the "sign fix" is INCORRECT.** The motors are **DFRobot FIT0441 with INVERTED PWM** → at the hardware level `255 - _pwmVal` is **correct**. The naïve "fix" of changing the sign (`analogWrite(_pwmVal)`) is **wrong and worsens the robot**. The real problem is the **control loop** (PID in **DIRECT** mode + `ki=22` dominant + `kp=0` → remains **fully saturated**): it is a **loop redesign, NOT a quick-win sign change.** Any document recommending "change the sign of the PWM" must be corrected with this reinterpretation.

**4.2 YOLO classes (#120 / B3) — are NOT inverted (nuanced).** The model classes **match** `metadata.yaml`. What was inverted were names of **sub-states of deposit**. Correct where it is stated flatly "YOLO classes inverted".

**4.3 Rescue runs on ghost code.** The non-blocking FSM of the claw (`actualizarRescate()`, `claw.cpp`) is **100% dead**; it runs the old **blocking inline** sequence (`main.cpp:1137-1186`). The team tunes code that does not execute.

**4.4 ESP32 NOT incorporated** (neither HW nor SW): it is just a proposal. Note: the firmware **has already remapped pins** (BUZZER 35→31, LED 34→30) for an ESP32 that was never mounted → inconsistent state.

**4.5 Expired dates.** Any document that says "free push until May 26", "freeze May 20", "T-7/T-6 weeks", "today 2026-05-18", etc. is **outdated**. Today is **May 31** (valid §2).

**4.6 PRs already in `main`.** `#100` / `#101` / `#119` marked "not merged" → they are already in `main` (see §1).
